scope.summary: Implement the base-mesh topology contract validator per Section 13.16 (BK-16.5), published as the BODY_TOPOLOGY_VALID ValidationDescriptor: watertight closed manifold, single connected component, quad-dominance threshold, region-mask completeness, genital-region edge loops present, pole/valence budget, and UDIM tile layout check (head/torso/limbs/genitals tiles).
acceptance_criteria: validate_topology(&BaseMesh, &RegionMaskSet) returns a typed report with one finding per check: watertight, single_component, quad_dominance (configurable ratio, default >= 0.95), region_mask_complete, genital_loops_present, pole_valence_budget (configurable max valence), udim_layout (expected tiles head/torso/limbs/genitals).
Each finding carries pass/fail, measured value, threshold, and a bounded sample of offending element ids (vertex/face indices).
The composite result registers as ValidationDescriptor BODY_TOPOLOGY_VALID consumable by the 13.15 validation runner without runner modification.
Fixtures include one passing mesh and at least four deliberately broken meshes (open boundary, two components, missing genital loops, unmasked vertices), each failing exactly its targeted check.
scope.risk_if_missed: Without a mechanical topology gate, a subtly broken base mesh (open seam, missing genital loops) becomes the anchor for hundreds of morph assets and is unfixable later without invalidating every delta — the highest-blast-radius single failure in BodyKit.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Bind topology, masks, landmarks, UVs, weights, provenance, and decoupling to the accepted asset pack and feathered support-domain contract.
